description: Multi-episode reliability checks of the cutting_research_v1 policy-ready env (supplement Test F). POLICY_READY is set only if every check of every episode passes and every stored episode validates with the dataset reader.

memory.note: Least-squares slope of the post-episode host RSS / process GPU memory over episodes >= fit_from_episode (episode 0 includes one-time kernel compilation and caches).

determinism.same_seed_same_controller_gpu_or_live: verdict identical; reported metrics compared, not gated

amendment: Only the tool-at-rest-after-reset rule changes. The smoke showed the PhysX instantaneous velocity of the physically clamped tool body is contact-solver jitter (|v| 3.6 mm/s, |w| 0.148 rad/s, bitwise identical in both resets) while the arm is at rest (|qdot| <= 8e-4 rad/s) and the runtime's pose-derived hand-tool speeds over the settle window are 6.1e-5 m/s and 8.5e-4 rad/s with 0.15 um drift (grasp receipt PASS_STABLE_GRASP). v1a therefore requires (a) the pose-derived settle-window speeds of the runtime grasp receipt (already gated by PASS_STABLE_GRASP: 1e-3 m/s, 1e-2 rad/s in the unchanged ToolGraspConfig) and (b) the instantaneous post-reset tool velocity to repeat episode 0 (state isolation) within the declared differences; the absolute instantaneous velocity is still recorded and the v1 rule is still evaluated and reported alongside.
